display.title: Episode 466: The Sly Fox and the Cheese (Rosh Chodesh Adar)
display.summary_short: Tzivos Hashem missions around the world, and the fable of a hungry fox who mistakes the moon's reflection for cheese and then tricks another fox into the well: a lesson about the yetzer hara.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on the eve of Rosh Chodesh Adar 5751. Uncle Yossi describes how Tzivos Hashem soldiers in many countries carry out missions of Ahavas Yisroel, such as finding children who do not know about Purim and sharing the Purim story with them, because one mitzvah leads to another. He invites listeners to send in their mission charts, or a letter describing their mitzvah, for extra points. After the Hakochainik march, a girl from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema and encourages everyone to join Tzivos Hashem, and everyone gives tzedakah. In the story, a starving fox sees what looks like cheese at the bottom of a well, rides a bucket down, and finds only water and the moon's reflection. He sings happily until a second fox comes along, tricks him into riding down, and rides up and away. Uncle Yossi explains that the yetzer hara is just as tricky, and gives three secret weapons against it: Torah, davening and tzedakah, including extra coins before Shabbos candle-lighting. The mailbox thanks two sisters who signed up new members, and the show ends with candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: The yetzer hara is tricky and only wants to pull you down with him; fight it with Torah, davening and tzedakah.

sources_cited.note: Torah, Avodah and Gemilus Chasadim as the three weapons against the yetzer hara.
